title: Absolute value
prompt: Return n if it is zero or positive. If n is negative, return -n so the result is positive. Do it with if and else rather than abs().
hints: Only negative numbers need changing; a minus sign in front flips the sign.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
